testo:
■ Mana Drive 2 (Light): If you have 2 or more cards in your mana zone and one or more of them is light civilization, this creature gets "Saver: Light creature". (When one of your light creatures would be destroyed, you may destroy the creature that has "Saver: Light creature" instead.)
Gacharange Reminder
